messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands Q&A — thanks for the answers earlier. A few folks pinged me: can we get a concise summary of the promotion timeline and when comp adjustments become effective?

Dalia: short answer from the panel: calibration finishes end of month, comp adjustments effective the next payroll cycle (usually first full pay period after the announcement). will confirm exact dates. :+1:

jonathan: expanding — we run calibration over two weeks (manager calibrations + committee), then People Ops finalizes letters. target effective date is the first pay period starting in the next month after letters are sent. for example, if letters go out June 20, comp changes hit payroll starting July 1 pay period.

alex: a couple of edge cases: what about mid-cycle promotions (e.g., someone promoted in March but review cycle is June)? are they retroactive or prorated?

jonathan: good Q. for promotions granted outside the standard cycle we typically set the effective date to the promotion decision date (no retroactive lump-sum). comp is adjusted going forward from that pay period. if a manager believes a retroactive lump-sum is warranted, raises should document the rationale and be routed to comp-review for approval.

kevin: for leveling changes (band changes without comp change), does the official title change immediately upon manager approval or after calibration?

Dalia: titles that affect external role naming are updated after calibration to keep things consistent. internal titles used in team org charts can be updated earlier if manager and TL agree, but official system-of-record (HRIS) updates happen post-calibration.

maria: can we get a checklist managers can follow? several managers asked for a one-pager with steps and links (calibration calendar, template language for letters, and how to submit exceptions).

jonathan: yes — we'll publish a manager checklist and a short FAQ. draft will include: links to calibration calendar, how to fill promotion form, exemption request process, and sample manager message. expect it tomorrow by EOD.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Promotion & Compensation docs updated — https://intranet.redwood/company/people-ops/promo-comp (internal).

maria: will the FAQ include guidance on external offers (counteroffers) and how that affects comp bands? some PMs asked about how we handle competing offers during calibration.

alex: small ask — can People Ops host 30-min office hours next week for managers? fast triage of edge cases would really help.

jonathan: yes. booking page will go live today. command to reserve (for managers):
```
/reserve people-ops-officehours 2026-04-06 10:00
```
Slots limited to 6 managers per slot; bring your case + docs.

maria: thanks — also, any update on transparency for comp bands? people asked if we can publish band medians per level (not individual comp).

Dalia: we can publish median and 25/75 percentiles per band (anonymized). will add to the FAQ and to the compensation section in the handbook.

kevin: last thing — promos for IC->Senior IC vs IC->Manager: are they treated differently for probation or ramp?

jonathan: promotions to manager include a 3-month leadership check-in and optional mentorship program; IC->Senior remains performance-based with a 6-month solidification period for expectations. details added to the manager checklist.

maria: perfect. if people have follow-ups I told them to drop them here and we'll loop back. tagging @jonathan and @dalia — thanks. :wave:
